spans.s: उः [uḥ], 1 N. of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ.
The orb of the moon; cf. also उर्गौरीपतिरुः कालः सेतुर्नाथः परायणः । नारदो$र्को$निलः पाशी मार्कण्डेयो$थ रावणः ॥ Ek. -ind.
As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः Sk.
An interjection of: (a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम
; (b) anger; (c) compassion; (d) command; (e) acceptance; (f) interrogation; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा

. or used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I ask &c.); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो), न (नो) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ-उ or उत on the one hand-on the other hand, partly-partly.
A protector; cf. ऊः परेतो$ण्डजस्त्वष्टा विवस्वानग्निसारथिः । वह्निर्निशाकरः पूर्णो दरिद्री सरमा- धिपः ॥ Ek. -ind.
A particle used to introduce a subject.
An interjection of (a) calling; (b) of compassion; (c) protection.
